form:FormGroup.label: Filter
form:FormGroup.helpText: Text to filter this column's values by. Plain text keeps rows whose value contains it; start with ! to exclude, or use operators such as =, >, < with and, or and not, e.g. >100 and <200.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Plain text matches values containing it. Operators such as >, = and ! are allowed.
